items.title: H3 Podcast's Ethan Klein Breaks Silence on Affair, Apologizes to Wife Hila
items.summary:
H3 Podcast cohost Ethan Klein is breaking his silence after his wife and costar, Hila Klein , accused of having a six-month affair .

In a statement posted via his Instagram Stories on Tuesday, November 24, Ethan, 41, admitted to his infidelity, apologizing to wife Hila, 38, for the end of their marriage, as well as the end of their long-running podcast.

“Let me begin by apologizing for my long silence. I’ve wanted to take my time to make my comments as thoughtful and sincere as possible,” he wrote. “Truthfully, I still have a lot to process and I still don’t fully understand many of the decisions I’ve made, but suffice to say this for now: I am sorry for the pain I’ve caused. It was selfish, pathetic, surreal… It was the ultimate betrayal to my wife, myself, and you, the audience.”

Ethan continued, “The disappointment and despair I’ve caused is immense, and I have so much to reckon with in coming to terms with what happened. I’m most sorry to Hila, to whom the word ‘sorry’ likely has the weight of ash, and so I will refrain from getting too deep into apologizing to her here. I could never say or do enough to make up for what I have put her through. We are coparents now, and even in her righteous indignation, she has been beyond graceful in her approach to me as her children’s father, and I’m so grateful to her for that.”

Hila Klein Shares More Details About Husband Ethan Klein's Alleged Affair 

“Regarding the affair, my explanation and involvement will come in time as I feel ready to maturely and thoughtfully address it with the seriousness it deserves,” he shared.…

items.title: 'Dancing With the Stars’ Winners Through the Years: Where Are They Now?
items.summary:
Throughout the years, Dancing With the Stars has crowned countless winners.

In June 2005, ABC launched the U.S. version of the U.K. series Strictly Come Dancing . Each season, a celebrity is partnered with a professional dancer as they tackle a new style of ballroom dance.

Carrie Ann Inaba , Bruno Tonioli and Len Goodman have served as judges since the series’ debut, with pro dancer Julianne Hough briefly joining the table for seasons 19-21, then again for seasons 23 and 24. During season 29, Goodman was also replaced, since he was unable to travel to L.A. due to the coronavirus pandemic. Former pro Derek Hough became the third judge and has become a staple of the panel since.

At the end of each season, one star claims the iconic mirrorball trophy. After Goodman’s death in 2023, the competition series renamed its coveted prize after the late judge.

Scroll through the gallery below to see every star who has won the reality show — including season 35 champ Ezra Frech — and where they are today:

During the freestyle round of the Tuesday, November 24, finale, Frech, 21, intentionally began the number without his blade attached. After he was taken behind a barrier, he returned with the prosthetic on. However, an unexpected glitch took place when the prosthetic came off during his dance with partner Daniella Karagach .

Despite the live snafu, Frech recovered and was able to get his prosthetic back on with the help of Karagach, 33, and the other performers. When the dance was over, they were met with a standing ovation from the judges.

Carrie Ann Inaba, Bruno Tonioli and Derek Hough all praised Frech for his recovery.

The fact that the worst case scenario might have happened and you wouldn’t even have known, the way you rose in that moment,” Hough, 41, said. “Ezra, you are incredible, man!”

Tonioli, 71, added, “What we witnessed tonight goes beyond dancing. This is a powerful, beautiful, life affirming statement that will inspire the nation and the world, my darling.”

items.title: 'DWTS' Officially Crowns Season 35 Winner: Who Took Home the Mirrorball?
items.summary:
Dancing With the Stars season 35 delivered one final bombshell on finale night, officially revealing a new ballroom champion.

The remaining five couples each performed three routines on Tuesday, November 24, with one style selected by a judge as a redemption dance. The finale also included freestyles and the instant dance challenge. After the showstopping performances, Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach were announced as the winners.

Previously eliminated season 35 contestants returned on Tuesday night to celebrate the finale, including Ciara Miller , Tyler Cameron and Jenna Dewan . Season 34 champ Robert Irwin also made an appearance with his former partner, Witney Carson .

Irwin, 22, recently weighed in on the competition ahead of finale night, telling Extra that it was still “anyone’s game.” He’s also been candid about how his experience on the show was a “dream” come true.

“It’s taught me a lot. … The two words that spring to my mind would be trust and vulnerability,” he told The Hollywood Reporter shortly after his win in November 2025. “I think having a sense of trust in the people around you, like for me, I had absolute and complete faith in Witney, and she had that same trust in me. I feel like we just both believed in each other 1,000 percent: We just knew whatever we would do, as long as it was fun and it felt right, it was going to be great. And also, I think personally, I found the moments where I let go the guard, the filter and just let the emotions just really be at that surface level and not care if I was crying or I was just ecstatically happy, whatever…
items.t: 'DWTS' Officially Crowns Season 35 Winner: Who Took Home the Mirrorball?

Dancing With the Stars pro Jan Ravnik was preemptively censored after his stunning freestyle with Tatyana Ali on finale night.

“No, I’m just extremely proud of her,” Ravnik, 31, told cohost Julianne Hough when asked about his emotions after their performance on Tuesday, November 24.

The audio then cut before Ali, 47, was heard screaming.

“I think you’re on somebody else’s bad list now,” Hough, 38, quipped, referring to Ravnik’s infamous “DTM List.” (Moments earlier, Hough asked Ravnik whether she was still on the “Dead to Me” list following their back-and-forth earlier this season.)

Tatyana Ali Reflects on Her 'DWTS' Body Transformation: 'Went Through a Lot' 

Fellow pro Alan Bersten revealed on the show’s official TikTok livestream that Ravnik had said the word “f***.” (The FCC has specific guidelines about what can be said live during primetime programs.)

Ravnik and Ali performed a showstopping freestyle set to “Minnie the Moocher” by Cab Calloway and “Over the Rainbow” by Judy Garland.

“Jan told me to tell him what my dream world was like, and he created this beautiful dance that’s a metaphor for my experience here,” Ali tearfully said from the skybox. “So it was fitting that it would be the last dance that we did.”

The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air alum is one of the five finalists closing out season 35, alongside Ezra Frech, Amber Glenn, Maura Higgins and Connor Wood . Each celeb danced three routines on Tuesday night with their pro partners.
